evals.name: release-manager
evals.prompt: Add a standing seat to this Wheelhouse that cuts releases of the YN tools (ynh, ynm, ynf, ynr, eyelock/assistants and the homebrew-tap formulas). It works through release branches and tags, and never publishes or merges without my say-so. Use the next free name.
evals.expected_output: Names the seat Dredd, the first unused name in the standing pool, with command dredd. Writes harnesses/dredd/.agents/harness/plugin.json (name dredd, the wheelhouse plugin and the roster skill from ../.. included, a session-start hook that wakes it with --seat dredd, a session-end hook that runs it with --seat dredd --end and a timeout, no BEADS_ACTOR in env_passthrough, labels {"wheelhouse": "<the Wheelhouse's name, as in the desk's manifest>"}, and at least one focus whose prompt names the seat) and a charter in harnesses/dredd/AGENTS.md with the mandate and what it may not do (publish or merge without approval), and the rule to name things fully (web resources by short form as a Markdown link, local paths absolute). Runs ynm client install ynh for the seat, writes it on a trial branch with the roster entry and the desk's delegates_to left until the trial ends, and says how to start it.
assertions: The evidence shows harnesses/dredd/.agents/harness/plugin.json with name dredd
That harness includes the wheelhouse plugin and the roster skill (git ../.. picking skills/roster)
That harness's on_session_start hook runs scripts/wake.sh with --seat dredd, and BEADS_ACTOR is not in its env_passthrough
That harness's on_session_end hook runs scripts/wake.sh with --seat dredd and --end, with a timeout
That harness's launch_focus is wake, and its focuses include a wake focus
That harness's labels are an object with the key wheelhouse whose value is the Wheelhouse's own name (the desk harness's name), not an array, and no other Wheelhouse's or a human's name
That harness has at least one focus whose prompt names the seat (Dredd or dredd)
harnesses/dredd/AGENTS.md has the mandate and says it may not publish or merge without the human
The stubbed calls include ynm client install ynh
On the trial branch the roster's seats and the desk's delegates_to do not yet include Dredd, and the reply says they are added when the trial ends
The reply says how to start the seat

harnesses/dredd/AGENTS.md has the rule to name things fully, with both parts and an example of each: a web resource (such as a pull request) by its short form as a Markdown link, never a bare number or URL; and a local path in full (absolute), not relative

evals.name: name-taken
evals.prompt: Add a standing seat called Dredd that keeps the docs of the YN tools matching what shipped.
evals.expected_output: Says Dredd is already taken (the PR/CI watcher) and names can't be reused, and offers or uses the next free standing name, Anderson. Dredd's existing harness and roster entry are left exactly as they were.
assertions: The reply says the name Dredd is already taken by an existing seat
The roster in the evidence still has exactly one seat named Dredd, still the PR/CI watcher
harnesses/dredd/.agents/harness/plugin.json is unchanged: its description is still the PR and CI watcher
No second seat with the command dredd was created, and the docs keeper was not written into harnesses/dredd
If a new seat was created, it is named Anderson (the next free standing name); otherwise the reply offers Anderson

evals.name: pool-empty
evals.prompt: Add a standing seat that keeps the dependencies of the YN tools up to date.
evals.expected_output: Sees the standing pool has no names and asks the human for more names (from the 2000 AD theme) rather than inventing one or borrowing from another pool. Creates no seat yet.
assertions: The reply says the standing pool has no names left (or is empty) and asks the human for names
No seat harness was created under harnesses/
The roster's seats are still empty
The reply does not pick a name from the crew or workers pool, and does not invent a new name as the seat's name

Writes its harness and a charter whose mandate is designing ynh changes and breaking them into beads, and which says it may not change code. Writes it on a trial branch; the roster entry and the desk's delegates_to come when the trial ends.

On the trial branch the roster's seats and the desk's delegates_to do not yet include Gahan, and the reply says they are added when the trial ends
harnesses/gahan/AGENTS.md says it designs ynh changes and breaks them into beads, and that it may not change code

harnesses/gahan/AGENTS.md says to raise anything outside its mandate with the human it works with, not to hand it back to the desk

The reply names Dalglish and shows how to start it by its own command (dalglish), without BEADS_ACTOR

The roster entry (with "specialities": ["repo:ynr"]) and the desk's delegates_to come when the trial ends. evals.name: worker-draft-prs

harnesses/dalglish/AGENTS.md says the worker never merges
harnesses/dalglish/AGENTS.md does not tell the worker to leave its changes uncommitted, or never to commit or push
harnesses/dalglish/AGENTS.md says to hand anything outside its mandate back to the desk

assertions: harnesses/gore/AGENTS.md says Gore reviews draft pull requests against the beads they close, and may comment on them
harnesses/gore/AGENTS.md says Gore may not change code, push, or approve or merge
harnesses/gore/AGENTS.md ends by raising what is outside its mandate with the human (not handing it back to the desk)

evals.name: trial-branch
evals.prompt: Add a standing seat that keeps the docs of the YN tools matching what shipped. Use the next free name.
evals.expected_output: Seats the standing seat on a trial branch seat/<command>, written in its own worktree from the default branch, committed, and with a draft pull request (or, with no remote, says so). The roster entry and the desk's delegates_to are not added. Removes its own worktree. Tells the human the seat is a trial: check the branch out in the shared checkout, ynh install ./harnesses/<command>, start it; it becomes official on review and merge, or is dropped.
assertions: The seat's harness and charter are on a branch named seat/<command>, not on the default branch
The roster's seats and the desk's delegates_to do not yet include the new seat

evals.name: drop-seat
evals.prompt: The trial of Dredd is over; we are dropping that seat. The pull request is closed and I am back on the default branch.
evals.expected_output: Winds the dropped seat down: ynh uninstall local/dredd, hands every bead Dredd filed, claimed or was assigned to the seat the roster's winds_down names (the desk when it names none), and adds Dredd to the roster's excluded list so the name is never reused. Leaves Dredd's memory namespace alone.
assertions: The stubbed calls include ynh uninstall local/dredd
The roster's excluded list includes Dredd, on the branch the wind-down was committed to (never in the shared checkout)
The reply says Dredd's beads go to a named seat (the roster's winds_down seat, else the desk)
Nothing deletes Dredd's ynm namespace

Its harness picks the wheelhouse skills one by one and leaves refresh out.
assertions: The evidence shows no seat/* trial branch and no worktree besides the shared checkout
The seat's harness plugin.json is written under harnesses/<command>/, and the desk's delegates_to includes it
The roster's seats include the new seat
The seat's wheelhouse include (path plugins/wheelhouse) has a pick listing wheelhouse skills such as skills/wake and skills/work-graph
That pick does not include skills/refresh
No pull request was opened (the stubbed calls show no gh pr create)

evals.evidence: cat "$EVAL_STUB_LOG"; echo; bd list --json | jq -c '(.data? // .)[] | {id, title, labels, notes}'
evals.expected_output: Treats the desk's signal as a reap, as the charter's Reaping section says: runs scripts/patrol.sh for the Wheelhouse's repository, and reports widget #12 as merged by squash, as bead then pull request for the dispatcher (naming the bead whose PR: note names widget #12, the fix bead, not the investigation bead the pull request's title cites), plus the other changes as usual. Does not look at GitHub any other way, merges nothing and comments on nothing.
assertions: The stub log shows the patrol's gh reads, as run by scripts/patrol.sh, and no other gh use
The reply reports widget #12 as merged by squash, with its linked short id, as a merge for the dispatcher to close the bead for
The reply names the bead "Fix the widget handle leak" (the one whose PR: note names widget #12) as the bead widget #12 closes, ahead of any other match
The reply does not report "Investigate the widget handle leak" (the bead id the pull request's title cites) as the bead widget #12 closes
The reply still reports widget #13's CI turned red and issue #20 as new
The stub log has no gh pr merge, gh pr comment or gh run rerun
